ideas.pitch: A wearable biomedical IoT vest for real-time post-operative patient monitoring with edge-computed anomaly alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare & Assistive Technology: Develop hardware-based solutions for healthcare monitoring, patient assistance, rehabilitation, biomedical instrumentation, and wearable health devices.
ideas.title: VitalsGuard: Post-Operative Bio-Telemetry Vest
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven biomedical IoT architectures and edge computing that judges can physically see working via a live sensor dashboard during the demo.

ideas.pitch: An automotive safety hardware prototype combining steering wheel biometric sensors and cabin computer vision to prevent driver-fatigue accidents.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Mobility & Automotive Technology: Build innovative solutions for electric vehicles, intelligent transportation, vehicle safety, autonomous mobility, smart traffic management, and automotive electronics.
ideas.title: LaneGuard: Intelligent Driver Fatigue and Drowsiness Interceptor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical automotive safety needs with tangible hardware components mounted directly onto a physical steering mock-up for immediate live testing.

ideas.pitch: An industrial IoT monitoring unit using accelerometer arrays and acoustic sensors to detect pipeline anomalies and preemptively shut off mechanical valves.
ideas.problem_statement: Industrial Automation: Explore automation, control systems, smart monitoring, industrial processes, and intelligent manufacturing solutions.
ideas.title: AutoValve: Industrial Pipeline Leak & Vibration Diagnostics Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets industrial automation priorities with rugged embedded hardware and an automated mechanical actuator response that makes for a high-impact physical demo.

ideas.pitch: A solar-powered agricultural sensor node communicating via LoRa mesh to optimize irrigation scheduling and drive remote water pumps autonomously.
ideas.problem_statement: Agriculture & Environment: Build technology-driven solutions addressing agricultural challenges, resource management, environmental monitoring, and sustainability.
ideas.title: AquaSense: LoRa-Enabled Precision Soil Moisture & Pump Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs robust low-power wireless mesh protocols suited for rural agricultural deployment, ensuring judges see a self-contained, long-range embedded system.
